settings.heading: Understand your constitution profile
settings.text: Notice recurring patterns across energy, temperature, digestion, sleep, mood, skin, and sensitivity. Your answers create a nine-dimension wellness profile and a rule-based product starting point.
settings.disclaimer: This quiz is intended for general wellness and lifestyle reference only and is not a medical diagnosis or a substitute for professional medical advice. If you have persistent symptoms, a known medical condition, take medication, are pregnant, or have known allergies, please consult a qualified healthcare professional before using any related product.
